verdict.rationale: LegalZoom documents compliance monitoring: annual-report reminders, real-time compliance-status notifications, license expiration alerts and a dashboard. These are all delivered as emails or in-app alerts to humans. Nothing shows a public API or registrable webhooks an agent could use to watch entity standing or filing deadlines. The llms.txt probe is crawler guidance, not a programmatic interface, so the story's agent-facing capability has no evidence.
